verses.jalalayn: ﻿When the heaven is split open, [when it is] rent asunder,

verses.saheeh: And when the stars fall, scattering,
verses.khattab: and when the stars fall away
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the stars are dispersed, [when] they expire and begin to fall,

verses.saheeh: And when the seas are erupted
verses.khattab: and when the seas burst forth
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the seas are burst forth, released one upon the other, forming one mass of water, so that the sweet [water] mixes with the salty;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jab samandar phaad diye jayengey

verses.saheeh: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,
verses.khattab: and when the graves spill out
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and when the tombs are overturned, [when] their earth [above them] is dug up and its dead are raised (the response to idhā, ‘when’, and all that is supplemented thereto is [the following]):
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jab qabrein khol di jayengi

verses.saheeh: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
verses.khattab: ˹then˺ each soul will know what it has sent forth or left behind
verses.jalalayn: ﻿a soul, every soul, will know, at the time of the [occurrence of the] things mentioned, which is the Day of Resurrection, what it has sent ahead, in the way of deeds, and, what [it has], left behind, of these and did not do.
verses.romanUrdu: Us waqt har shaks ko uska agla pichla sab kiya dhara maloom ho jayega

verses.uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
verses.indopak: يٰۤاَيُّهَا الۡاِنۡسَانُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ الۡكَرِيۡمِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: ya ayyuha alinsanu ma gharraka birabbika alkareemi
verses.saheeh: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
verses.khattab: O humanity! What has emboldened you against your Lord, the Most Generous
verses.jalalayn: ﻿O, disbelieving, man! What has deceived you with regard to your generous Lord?, so that you have disobeyed Him,
verses.romanUrdu: Aey insaan kis cheez ne tujhey apne uss Rubb-e-kareem ki taraf se dhoke mein daal diya

verses.saheeh: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
verses.khattab: Who created you, fashioned you, and perfected your design
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Who created you, when you were not, then made you upright, in your created form, with sound limbs, then proportioned you (read fa-‘adalak or fa-‘addalak), making you symmetrical in shape, with well-proportioned parts, so that no hand or leg is longer than the other,
verses.romanUrdu: Jisne tujhey paida kiya, tujhey nek-suk se durust kiya(shaped you), tujhe mutanasib(well-proportioned) banaya

verses.uthmani: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
verses.indopak: فِىۡۤ اَىِّ صُوۡرَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ ؕ
verses.saheeh: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
verses.khattab: moulding you in whatever form He willed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿assembling you in whatever (mā is a relative) form He will?
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jis surat mein chaha tujhko jodh kar tayyar kiya

verses.saheeh: No! But you deny the Recompense.
verses.khattab: But no! In fact, you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿No indeed! — a deterrent against letting oneself be misled by the generosity of God, exalted be He. Rather you, that is, disbelievers of Mecca, deny Judgement, requital for deeds;
verses.romanUrdu: Hargiz nahin balke (asal baat yeh hai ke) tumlog jaza-o-saza ko jhutlate ho

verses.saheeh: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
verses.khattab: while you are certainly observed by vigilant
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Yet lo! there are above you watchers, from among the angels, over your deeds,
﻿noble, in God’s sight, writers, of these [deeds],
﻿who know whatever you do, all of it.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo tumharey har fail(amal) ko jantey hain

verses.saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
verses.khattab: Indeed, the virtuous will be in bliss
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed the pious, the believers who are sincere in their faith, shall be amid bliss, [in] Paradise,
verses.romanUrdu: Yaqeenan neik log mazey mei hongey

verses.saheeh: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
verses.khattab: and the wicked will be in Hell
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and indeed the profligates, the disbelievers, shall be in Hell-fire, a scorching fire,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur beshak badkar log jahannam me jayenge

verses.saheeh: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
verses.khattab: burning in it on Judgment Day
verses.jalalayn: ﻿entering it, to suffer its heat, on the Day of Judgement, [the Day of] Requital,
verses.romanUrdu: Jaza ke din woh is mein daakhil hongey

verses.saheeh: And never therefrom will they be absent.
verses.khattab: and they will have no escape from it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and they shall not be absent from it, [they shall not] be taken out of it.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur us se hargiz gayab na ho sakengey

verses.saheeh: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
verses.khattab: What will make you realize what Judgment Day is
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And what would show you, [what would] inform you, what the Day of Judgement is?
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tum kya jaante ho ke woh jaza ka din kya hai

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ مَاۤ اَدۡرٰٮكَ مَا يَوۡمُ الدِّيۡنِ ؕ
verses.transliteration: thumma ma adraka ma yawmu alddeeni
verses.saheeh: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
verses.khattab: Again, what will make you realize what Judgment Day is
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Again, what would show you what the Day of Judgement is? — [repeated] to emphasise its enormity.
verses.romanUrdu: Haan tumhein kya khabar ke woh jaza ka din kya hai

verses.uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
verses.indopak: يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسٌ لِّنَفۡسٍ شَيۡـــًٔا ؕ وَالۡاَمۡرُ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ لِّلَّهِ
verses.transliteration: yawma la tamliku nafsun linafsin shayan waalamru yawmaithin lillahi
verses.saheeh: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
verses.khattab: ˹It is˺ the Day no soul will be of ˹any˺ benefit to another whatsoever, for all authority on that Day belongs to Allah ˹entirely˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[It is] a day (read yawmu) when no soul will be of any avail, any use, to another soul, and the [absolute] command on that day will be God’s: there will be no [power of] command for anyone other than Him thereat, in other words, none has been given the power to mediate thereupon, in contrast to [situations] in this world.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh woh din hai jab kisi shaks ke liye kuch karna kisi ke bas mei na hoga, faisla us din bilkul Allah ke ikhtiyar mein hoga
